demand_construction.finding: Adjacent admissibility, node-activation, and minimal-micro-node rules exist, but no located implementation directly performs active admissible capable-node resolution followed by node construction only when no such node exists.

expiry_and_usage_retention.finding: Credential, session, delegation, and continuity lease expiry surfaces exist elsewhere, but no located source directly establishes PAT-001 default micro-node expiry plus externally evidenced usage-only retention.

heartbeat_non_authority.boundary: This does not verify heartbeat_non_self_retention; the inspected micro-node lifecycle still lacks a retention decision that rejects heartbeat-only persistence.

explicit_negative_findings.basis: MicroNodeRequest and evaluate_transition expose no expiry, TTL, expires_at, or deadline field or branch.
No lease, usage counter, renewal, delayed expiry, or usage-retention state exists in the inspected contracts or runtime.
Payload is accepted as an unbounded dictionary and no context window, reuse bound, eviction, or retention policy is evaluated.

No heartbeat field, liveness loop, persistence decision, or rule preventing heartbeat-only retention exists in the inspected surface. Separate StegOS evidence now corroborates HeartBeat non-authority, but not this lifecycle-retention proposition.
The runtime evaluates a supplied MicroNodeRequest but does not resolve or construct nodes from demand; bounded 2026-09-14 repository investigation did not locate a direct replacement implementation.
Authority and admissibility are evaluated from supplied delegation and policy references, but no registry lookup or capability-selection algorithm is executed.

retry_triggers: a later micro-node-runtime commit adds expiry, lease, context, heartbeat, registry lookup, or demand-construction behavior
an exact implementation path is supplied from another repository
